name: io.github.etherversecodemate/khepra-mcp
description: Post-quantum MCP security layer that signs, validates, and records agent tool calls for regulated AI workflows.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_MANIFEST_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the signed KHEPRA MCP tool manifest inside the runtime.

environmentVariables.name: PHANTOM_SYMBOL
environmentVariables.description: Adinkra symbol used for the local PQC session fingerprint.

environmentVariables.name: PHANTOM_IMAGE
environmentVariables.description: Optional Docker image used by sandboxed tools such as ert_scan.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_MCP_STRICT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to fail closed when Docker sandbox execution is unavailable.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_SERVICE_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional service secret used by protected KHEPRA integrations.
